decisions.reason: The ESD-device wiring correction preserves the existing native USB data lines and enumeration requirements; it does not change their required modes, orientations, or behavior.
Connecting the USBLC6 supply pins correctly does not change the standalone LDO, source-selection behavior, powered rail, or standalone-programming supply requirement.
The USB ESD-device pin correction is unrelated to the SPS30 connector, power, I2C signals, and SEL connection.
The source changes USBLC6 wiring only and does not affect the addressable LEDs' supply, data GPIO, level shifting, or power control.
The USB data-line protection correction does not alter the e-paper backlight's supply, switching, brightness control, or component population.
The source does not change any sensor connector, fanout, cable, or interboard-connector policy.
D+/D- routing through the USB ESD device is independent of I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, and bus speed.
The USBLC6 pin correction does not alter the panel button connector or its PWRON connection and behavior.
USB data-line ESD protection is separate from battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, and DW01A protection behavior.
The source does not change the battery NTC terminal, connector, controller, or thermal-protection behavior.
The source specifies a schematic wiring correction but does not change the tracked power-board BOM requirements or any of their current component attributes.
The USBLC6 supply and data-pin wiring correction does not alter the ESP32 local or bulk decoupling requirements.
